headline: FOUR HALLS replays on a seed — 31 arcade titles now report+pin
lede: The last seeded straggler in the arcade gets the #737 seed contract: a filed Four Halls report now carries its seed, and ?seed=N rebuilds the exact dungeon that was filed.

notes.text: Four Halls now reports its seed with every feedback note and honors ?seed=N at start — Gauntlet's proven pattern, same seed domain. What you filed is what a fixer replays.
The rollout floor in feedbackcheck moved to 31: 31 arcade titles report+pin their seeds, and any regression below that now fails CI.

This increment existed because a rival lane's own note said batch 2 should have caught it: FourHalls rolls its seed inline as Math.random()%97, a form the batch-inventory regexes never matched. Honest inventory beats memory.

Two lanes, one issue, zero fights: slot a waited out slot b's live lock, declared a one-PR shift on the issue, sequenced its PR behind b's batch 4, and shipped after — both merges landed clean tonight.
